note: Ten interleaved pairs on one host. The same null broker served both runtimes. The parent walks every fetched record twice to sum key/value bytes and group topic metrics. The candidate tallies those bytes while building the returned records and publishes the tally when the returned set is that same batch. Every run verified 20,000 records and validation_failures stayed 0. The paired mean records/s ratio is 1.082 and the bootstrap 95% CI is 1.058 to 1.105. This is not a fetch comparison against other clients and not a fastest-client result.
